title: Reading Comprehension and Text Interpretation — Level 8 — Arrange the story

items.prompt: Bromo recount: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) Then we walked to the crater and watched the sunrise. (2) Last holiday, my family visited Mount Bromo. (3) It was a tiring but unforgettable trip. (4) We left the hotel at 3 a.m. by jeep.

items.reteach: Recount: orientasi (2), urutan kejadian (4, 1), lalu kesan penutup (3).

items.prompt: Soekarno biography: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) As a young man, he studied in Bandung. (2) Soekarno was born in Surabaya in 1901. (3) In 1945 he read the Proclamation of Independence with Hatta. (4) He became the first President of Indonesia.

items.reteach: Biografi disusun kronologis: lahir, sekolah, proklamasi 1945, lalu menjadi presiden.

items.prompt: Peacock story: Which order makes a good narrative?

stimulus.text: (1) When a storm came, the sparrow hid in a hole, but the peacock's long tail got stuck in a bush. (2) Since that day, the peacock has never laughed at the sparrow again.
(3) A proud peacock always laughed at a sparrow's plain brown feathers. (4) The sparrow called the other birds, and together they pulled the peacock free.

items.prompt: Science fair recount: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) After that, each team presented to the judges. (2) At the end, our team won second place. (3) Last Friday, our school held a science fair. (4) In the morning, we set up our water-filter model.

items.reteach: Mulai dari orientasi (3), pagi hari (4), setelah itu (1), dan akhirnya (2).

items.prompt: Ki Hajar Dewantara biography: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) His birthday, 2 May, is now National Education Day. (2) In 1922 he founded Taman Siswa. (3) After independence, he became the first Minister of Education. (4) Ki Hajar Dewantara was born in 1889.

items.reteach: Kronologis: lahir 1889 (4), Taman Siswa 1922 (2), menteri setelah merdeka (3), lalu warisannya (1).

items.prompt: Madura study-tour recount: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) We crossed the Suramadu Bridge early in the morning. (2) In the afternoon, we watched a karapan sapi race. (3) Last month, my class went on a study tour to Madura. (4) We got home tired but happy.

items.prompt: Story of the lost wallet: Which order makes a good narrative?

stimulus.text: (1) Raka found a wallet near the bus stop. (2) The owner, an old woman, thanked him warmly. (3) He decided to take it to the police station at once. (4) Later that day, the police called the owner.

items.reteach: Raka menemukan dompet (1), memutuskan ke kantor polisi (3), polisi menghubungi pemilik (4), pemilik berterima kasih (2).

items.prompt: Storm recount: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) Then the electricity went off, so we lit candles. (2) Last night, a heavy storm hit our village. (3) The next morning, we helped clear the fallen branches. (4) Strong winds blew down many trees.

items.reteach: Orientasi badai (2), angin merobohkan pohon (4), listrik padam (1), pagi berikutnya (3).

items.prompt: Text structure: The sentence in the box is the ___ of a recount text.

stimulus.text: Last Sunday, I joined a beach clean-up in Kenjeran with my scout group.

items.reteach: Orientation memperkenalkan siapa, kapan, dan di mana.

items.prompt: Narrative structure: Which part of a narrative is the sentence in the box most likely from?

stimulus.text: Suddenly, the boat's engine stopped in the middle of the lake, and dark clouds began to gather.

items.reteach: Complication = munculnya masalah (mesin mati, awan gelap).

items.prompt: Recount structure: The sentence in the box is most likely the …

stimulus.text: Overall, it was the best holiday I have ever had, and I hope to go back next year.

items.reteach: Reorientation berisi kesan atau penutup di akhir recount.

items.prompt: Story about Sari: Which sentence is the best resolution for the story?

stimulus.text: Sari got lost in a big market in Surabaya. She was scared and started to cry.

visual.text: A kind seller called the market office, and soon her mother came to pick her up.

choices.say: A kind seller called the market office, and soon her mother came to pick her up.

visual.text: Sari lives in a small house near the market.

choices.say: Sari lives in a small house near the market.

visual.text: One morning, Sari went to the market with her mother.

choices.say: One morning, Sari went to the market with her mother.

visual.text: Suddenly, Sari could not see her mother anywhere.

choices.say: Suddenly, Sari could not see her mother anywhere.

items.prompt: Ijen story: How is the guide's first sentence reported?

stimulus.text: At the edge of Ijen, the guide warned us. He said, "The crater is very deep. Stay behind the line."

visual.text: The guide said that the crater was very deep.

choices.say: The guide said that the crater was very deep.

visual.text: The guide said that the crater is being very deep.

choices.say: The guide said that the crater is being very deep.

visual.text: The guide said that the crater had been very deep.

choices.say: The guide said that the crater had been very deep.

visual.text: The guide told that the crater was very deep.

choices.say: The guide told that the crater was very deep.

items.reteach: Reported speech: is menjadi was; "told" membutuhkan objek (told us).
